message: Hi, my little one Ana is 5 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hi! Yes, we do have Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu classes for 5-year-olds. It's a great age to start! The classes are age-appropriate and focus on building skills in a fun, safe environment. Would you like to schedule a free trial class for Ana?
Yes, I’d love to schedule a free trial class for Ana! What times do you have available?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial details to?
You can send the details to tester.cobble@gmail.com.
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! Last thing - what's Ana's date of birth? I need that to get her into the right class group.

Perfect! Ana will be in our Kids 3-6 Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu class. Here are some available times for her free trial:

Monday 7/13 at 4:00 PM
Tuesday 7/14 at 4:00 PM
Wednesday 7/15 at 4:00 PM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with Tuesday, 7/14 at 4:00 PM. Thank you!

Perfect! Ana is all set for Tuesday, July 14th at 4:00 PM for her free trial class. We'll send the details to tester.cobble@gmail.com. Just bring comfortable clothes she can move in. We're excited to meet Ana! See you then!
